translations.literal: Guangxu year 1, yihai.
translations.idiomatic: The first year of the Guangxu reign (yihai).

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuxu, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the fifth month he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jihai, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the ninth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Name changed.
translations.idiomatic: His name was changed.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未遷。十二月辛未左副都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiwei, transferred. Twelfth month, day xinwei, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the eleventh month he was transferred; on the xinwei day of the twelfth month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 2, bingzi.
translations.idiomatic: The second year of the Guangxu reign (bingzi).

sentences.zh: 十月甲寅遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiayin, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the tenth month he was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月甲寅遷。理藩院左侍郎。十一月乙未遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiayin, transferred. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister. Eleventh month, day yiwei, transferred. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the tenth month he was transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the yiwei day of the eleventh month he was transferred again, retaining that same post.

sentences.zh: 十月甲寅遷。理藩院右侍郎。十一月乙未遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiayin, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister. Eleventh month, day yiwei, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the tenth month he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the yiwei day of the eleventh month he was transferred again, retaining that same post.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 3, dingchou.
translations.idiomatic: The third year of the Guangxu reign (dingchou).

translations.literal: First month, day guihai, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the first month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingyin, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the ninth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 遷。十月丁酉左副都御史。

translations.literal: Transferred. Tenth month, day dingyou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred; on the dingyou day of the tenth month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子病免。十二月丁酉左副都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi, dismissed on account of illness. Twelfth month, day dingyou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the eleventh month he was dismissed because of illness; on the dingyou day of the twelfth month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 4, wuyin.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth year of the Guangxu reign (wuyin).

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥遷。左都御史。五月辛亥遷。左都御史。癸亥遷。左都御史。十二月癸卯遷。左都御史。署。

translations.literal: Third month, day guihai, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Fifth month, day xinhai, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Day guihai, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, day guimao, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the third month, the xinhai day of the fifth month, again on guihai, and the guimao day of the twelfth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief, serving in the end in an acting capacity.

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuchen, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the fifth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥遷。六月己丑左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinhai, transferred. Sixth month, day jichou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the fifth month he was transferred; on the jichou day of the sixth month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guimao, transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the twelfth month he was transferred.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 5, jimao.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth year of the Guangxu reign (jimao).

sentences.zh: 五月甲午遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiawu, transferred. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fifth month he was transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 正月戊辰休。理藩院右侍郎。二月癸未遷。理藩院右侍郎。五月甲午遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day wuchen, leave of absence. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister. Second month, day guiwei, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister. Fifth month, day jiawu, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the first month he took leave as Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the guiwei day of the second month and the jiawu day of the fifth month he was transferred, retaining that same post.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳開缺。辛卯左都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guisi, post left vacant. Day xinmao, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the eleventh month the post was left vacant; on the xinmao day he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 正月庚午遷。左都御史。三月乙卯遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: First month, day gengwu, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Third month, day yimao, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the first month and the yimao day of the third month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 正月戊辰遷。三月壬子左副都御史。

translations.literal: First month, day wuchen, transferred. Third month, day renzi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the first month he was transferred; on the renzi day of the third month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: First month, day renshen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the first month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月庚申遷。六月庚戌左副都御史。己未劾免。八月壬寅左副都御史。未任。丙午署。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day gengshen, transferred. Sixth month, day gengxu, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Day jiwei, dismissed after impeachment. Eighth month, day renyin, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Did not take office. Day bingwu, acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the fourth month he was transferred; on the gengxu day of the sixth month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on jiwei he was dismissed after impeachment; on the renyin day of the eighth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief but never took office; on the bingwu day he served in an acting capacity.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 6, gengchen.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth year of the Guangxu reign (gengchen).

sentences.zh: 十月壬戌卒。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renxu, died. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the tenth month he died in office as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renxu, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the tenth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十月壬戌遷。十一月戊子左副都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renxu, transferred. Eleventh month, day wuzi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the tenth month he was transferred; on the wuzi day of the eleventh month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Still acting.
translations.idiomatic: He continued to serve in an acting capacity.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 7, xinsi.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh year of the Guangxu reign (xinsi).

sentences.zh: 十月癸酉遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guiyou, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the tenth month he was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guiyou, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the tenth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳休。七月辛未左副都御史。未任。署。十二月癸未改署。署左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guisi, leave of absence. Seventh month, day xinwei, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Did not take office. Acting. Twelfth month, day guiwei, changed to acting. Acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the fifth month he took leave; on the xinwei day of the seventh month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief but did not take office and served only in an acting capacity; on the guiwei day of the twelfth month his appointment was changed to acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月乙巳遷。己酉署左副都御史。十二月遷。署。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day yisi, transferred. Day jiyou, acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, transferred. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the fourth month he was transferred; on jiyou he was appointed acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; in the twelfth month he was transferred again, serving in an acting capacity.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 8, renwu.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth year of the Guangxu reign (renwu).

sentences.zh: 休。正月辛亥理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Leave of absence. First month, day xinhai, Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was on leave; on the xinhai day of the first month he served as Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: First month, day xinhai, dismissed. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the first month he was dismissed from his post as Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jisi, stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the twelfth month he was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申遷。七月左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wushen, transferred. Seventh month, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the fifth month he was transferred; in the seventh month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月丙戌遷。署左副都御史。十一月癸巳休致。署。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingxu, transferred. Acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Eleventh month, day guisi, retired. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the fourth month he was transferred and appointed acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the guisi day of the eleventh month he retired, having served in an acting capacity.

translations.literal: Third month, took office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he assumed office.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 9, guiwei.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth year of the Guangxu reign (guiwei).

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅遷。理藩院尚書。六月己巳遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiayin, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister. Sixth month, day jisi, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the second month and the jisi day of the sixth month he was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jisi, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the sixth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: First month, day dingwei, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the first month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Still acting.
translations.idiomatic: He continued to serve in an acting capacity.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 10, jiashen.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth year of the Guangxu reign (jiashen).

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅遷。理藩院尚書。五月戊子遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister. Fifth month, day wuzi, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the third month and the wuzi day of the fifth month he was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅遷。左都御史。五月戊子遷。左都御史。八月乙酉遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Fifth month, day wuzi, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Eighth month, day yiyou, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the third month, the wuzi day of the fifth month, and the yiyou day of the eighth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the third month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinsi, transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the twelfth month he was transferred.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅遷。四月己巳左副都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin, transferred. Fourth month, day jisi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the third month he was transferred; on the jisi day of the fourth month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅赴福建。署左副都御史。十月甲戌遷。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin, sent to Fujian. Acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Tenth month, day jiaxu, transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the fifth month he was dispatched to Fujian as acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the jiaxu day of the tenth month he was transferred.

sentences.zh: 免。八月乙亥左副都御史。署。

translations.literal: Dismissed. Eighth month, day yihai, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed; on the yihai day of the eighth month he was appointed acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 11, yiyou.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh year of the Guangxu reign (yiyou).

translations.literal: First month, day gengwu, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the first month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Still acting.
translations.idiomatic: He continued to serve in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰差。署左副都御史。八月差。己巳署。十一月丙申改署。戊申署左副都御史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengchen, assigned on special duty. Acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Eighth month, special duty. Day jisi, acting. Eleventh month, day bingshen, changed to acting. Day wushen, acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the sixth month he was assigned on special duty as acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; in the eighth month he was again assigned on special duty; on jisi he served as acting; on the bingshen day of the eleventh month his appointment was changed to acting; on the wushen day he was appointed acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 12, bingxu.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth year of the Guangxu reign (bingxu).

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiaxu, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the second month he was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰病休。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengchen, sick leave. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the second month he took sick leave as Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月卒。辛酉理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, died. Day xinyou, Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he died; on the xinyou day he was succeeded as Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申遷。七月戊戌左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wushen, transferred. Seventh month, day wuxu, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the fifth month he was transferred; on the wuxu day of the seventh month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 13, dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: The thirteenth year of the Guangxu reign (dinghai).

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingwei, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the twelfth month he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Second month, day xinhai, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the second month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 14, wuzi.
translations.idiomatic: The fourteenth year of the Guangxu reign (wuzi).

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午卒。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu, died. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the eleventh month he died in office as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Third month, day guihai, transferred. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the third month he was transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinchou, transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the twelfth month he was transferred.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 15, jichou.
translations.idiomatic: The fifteenth year of the Guangxu reign, jichou cycle year.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingchen, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the ninth month he was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingchen, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the ninth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Second month, day xinsi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the second month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 遷。二月丁亥左副都御史。五月己酉病解。六月戊寅左副都御史。

translations.literal: Transferred. Second month, day dinghai, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Fifth month, day jiyou, dismissed on account of illness. Sixth month, day wuyin, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred; on the dinghai day of the second month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the jiyou day of the fifth month he was relieved because of illness; on the wuyin day of the sixth month he was again appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰遷。三月癸酉左副都御史。八月壬寅差。署左副都御史。十一月丁未遷。署左副都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiachen, transferred. Third month, day guiyou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Eighth month, day renyin, assigned on special duty. Acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Eleventh month, day dingwei, transferred. Acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the second month he was transferred; on the guiyou day of the third month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; in the eighth month, on renyin, he was assigned on special duty as acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the dingwei day of the eleventh month he was transferred again, serving in an acting capacity.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 16, gengyin.
translations.idiomatic: The sixteenth year of the Guangxu reign, gengyin cycle year.

sentences.zh: 十月乙卯理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day yimao, Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the tenth month he became Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰遷。壬午左都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengchen, transferred. Day renwu, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the second month he was transferred; on the renwu day he became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jichou, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the eleventh month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 17, xinmao.
translations.idiomatic: The seventeenth year of the Guangxu reign, xinmao cycle year.

sentences.zh: 遷。十一月丁卯左都御史。

translations.literal: Transferred. Eleventh month, day dingmao, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred; on the dingmao day of the eleventh month he became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 五月差。署左副都御史。十月癸丑署左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, assigned on special duty. Acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Tenth month, day guichou, acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was assigned on special duty as acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the guichou day of the tenth month he again served as acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 遷。五月己巳左副都御史。

translations.literal: Transferred. Fifth month, day jisi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred; on the jisi day of the fifth month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 18, renchen.
translations.idiomatic: The eighteenth year of the Guangxu reign, renchen cycle year.

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the eighth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 遷。八月丙子左副都御史。未任。署。

translations.literal: Transferred. Eighth month, day bingzi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Did not take office. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred; on the bingzi day of the eighth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief but never took office and served only in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子遷。閏六月丙寅左副都御史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuzi, transferred. Intercalary sixth month, day bingyin, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the sixth month he was transferred; in the intercalary sixth month, on the bingyin day, he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 19, guisi.
translations.idiomatic: The nineteenth year of the Guangxu reign, guisi cycle year.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiyou, transferred. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the ninth month he was transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiyou, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the ninth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Still acting.
translations.idiomatic: He continued to serve in an acting capacity.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 20, jiawu.
translations.idiomatic: The twentieth year of the Guangxu reign, jiawu cycle year.

sentences.zh: 正月壬寅休。癸卯理藩院尚書。八月甲子遷。乙丑理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: First month, day renyin, leave of absence. Day guimao, Lifan Yuan Minister. Eighth month, day jiazi, transferred. Day yichou, Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the first month he took leave; on guimao he became Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the jiazi day of the eighth month he was transferred; on yichou he was again appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 正月壬寅休。癸卯理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day renyin, leave of absence. Day guimao, Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the first month he took leave; on guimao he became Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 正月壬寅降。癸卯理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day renyin, demoted. Day guimao, Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the first month he was demoted; on guimao he became Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: First month, day guimao, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the first month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 辛卯卒。八月甲子左副都御史。

translations.literal: Day xinmao, died. Eighth month, day jiazi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day he died; on the jiazi day of the eighth month he was succeeded as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 21, yiwei.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-first year of the Guangxu reign, yiwei cycle year.

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jimao, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the sixth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiyou, dismissed on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the twelfth month he was dismissed because of illness.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 22, bingshen.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-second year of the Guangxu reign, bingshen cycle year.

sentences.zh: 四月庚寅遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day gengyin, transferred. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the fourth month he was transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinmao, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the tenth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: First month, day yichou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the first month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌遷。左副都御史。未任。署左副都御史。十二月卒。壬戌署。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renxu, transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Did not take office. Acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, died. Day renxu, acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the fifth month he was transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief but did not take office and served only as acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; in the twelfth month he died, having served in an acting capacity since renxu.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 23, dingyou.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-third year of the Guangxu reign, dingyou cycle year.

sentences.zh: 七月壬辰遷。左都御史。九月戊子遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day renchen, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Ninth month, day wuzi, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the seventh month and the wuzi day of the ninth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 八月遷。九月甲辰左副都御史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, transferred. Ninth month, day jiachen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he was transferred; on the jiachen day of the ninth month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 24, wuxu.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-fourth year of the Guangxu reign, wuxu cycle year.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiawu, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the eighth month he was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 正月癸丑卒。甲寅理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day guichou, died. Day jiayin, Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the first month he died; on the jiayin day he was succeeded as Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午遷。丙申左都御史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiawu, transferred. Day bingshen, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the eighth month he was transferred; on the bingshen day he became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 遷。五月戊午左副都御史。六月庚午革。癸酉左副都御史。

translations.literal: Transferred. Fifth month, day wuwu, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Sixth month, day gengwu, stripped of office. Day guiyou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred; on the wuwu day of the fifth month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the gengwu day of the sixth month he was stripped of office; on the guiyou day he was again appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十月癸未遷。十一月壬戌左副都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guiwei, transferred. Eleventh month, day renxu, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the tenth month he was transferred; on the renxu day of the eleventh month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 25, jihai.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-fifth year of the Guangxu reign, jihai cycle year.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinyou, transferred. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the ninth month he was transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯遷。左都御史。十一月己巳遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yimao, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Eleventh month, day jisi, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the fifth month and the jisi day of the eleventh month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 六月假。七月癸丑左副都御史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, leave of absence. Seventh month, day guichou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he took leave; on the guichou day of the seventh month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月辛卯遷。五月庚戌左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day xinmao, transferred. Fifth month, day gengxu, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the fourth month he was transferred; on the gengxu day of the fifth month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Guangxu year 26, gengzi.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-sixth year of the Guangxu reign, gengzi cycle year.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯遷。理藩院尚書。十二月戊戌卒。辛丑理藩院尚書。十二月丙寅遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingmao, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister. Twelfth month, day wuxu, died. Day xinchou, Lifan Yuan Minister. Twelfth month, day bingyin, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the eighth month he was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the wuxu day of the twelfth month he died; on xinchou he was succeeded as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the bingyin day of the twelfth month he was transferred again to that same office.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅遷。理藩院左侍郎。八月庚辰遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiayin, transferred. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister. Eighth month, day gengchen, transferred. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the fifth month and the gengchen day of the eighth month he was transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯遷。左都御史。九月壬辰革。尋論斬。左都御史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingmao, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Ninth month, day renchen, stripped of office. Soon sentenced to decapitation. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the eighth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief; on the renchen day of the ninth month he was stripped of office and soon sentenced to decapitation while still holding the title of Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月戊戌遷。左都御史。九月丙午病免。左都御史。九月丁丑遷。左都御史。九月戊子遷。補。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wuxu, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Ninth month, day bingwu, dismissed on account of illness. Left Censor-in-Chief. Ninth month, day dingchou, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Ninth month, day wuzi, transferred. To fill vacancy.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the fourth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief; on the bingwu day of the ninth month he was dismissed because of illness; on the dingchou and wuzi days of the ninth month he was transferred again to fill the vacancy as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳左副都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jisi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the eleventh month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月戊戌遷。五月戊申左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wuxu, transferred. Fifth month, day wushen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the fourth month he was transferred; on the wushen day of the fifth month he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
